thread:
mike: Heads-up team — third-party pen test booked Mon 09:30am PT (vendor: RedAnchor). In-scope: prod API gateway, model-serving cluster, CI artifact registry. We need: RBAC snapshot, KMS ephemeral access plan, immutable audit export, evidence manifest, retest slots, and an incident escalation crib. Can we split? :clipboard:
sana: I can take RBAC snapshot + initial vuln triage board. Post exact project IDs & SAs and I'll run exports.
sam: Ill own the tracker and retest scheduling. Please confirm available windows next week (AM/PM preferred).
kevin: I can do the KMS ephemeral bindings and IAM condition PR. Confirming decrypt-only for artifact keys (no sign/verify). @anita any legal constraints we should encode?
anita: Decrypt-only fine. Legal requires an evidence_receipt.txt with signer name and role. Default retention 90 days; extend if assessors request. Redact any prompt content before export.
ryan: Ill handle audit log snapshot + set bucket hold and immutability. Plan to run pre-engagement snapshot 20m before start and copy into gs://pt-evidence/2145009999/ with hold.
devops-bot: Temporary role request created: PT-2145009999. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Request: https://ops.internal/requests/2145009999 :white_check_mark:
sana: RBAC export command I'll run (example):

```
rbac-export --projects=redwood-prod,redwood-staging --format=json \ 
  --out=rbac-2145009999.json
gsutil cp rbac-2145009999.json gs://pt-evidence/2145009999/
```
kevin: IAM snippet I plan to apply (time-bound). Will gate apply to 10m before start and auto-remove after window. Example in PR:

```
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:pt-redanchor@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    condition:
      title: "pt-ephemeral"
      expression: "request.time >= timestamp('2026-07-12T16:20:00Z') && request.time <= timestamp('2026-07-12T18:20:00Z')"
```
anita: Also add a manifest.csv listing files + sha256, and a signed evidence_receipt.txt (name, role, time). Note the manifest must include redaction notes and checksum verification steps.
ryan: Audit snapshot command I will use (pre-start):

```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql "SELECT * FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)" > audit-snap-2145009999.json
gsutil cp audit-snap-2145009999.json gs://pt-evidence/2145009999/
```
mike: Proposed retest slots: Tue-Fri next week, AM slot 09:00-11:00 and PM slot 14:00-16:00. Sam, can you create the board and assign owners/severity buckets?
sam: Yep — will seed buckets: creds-exposure, authz, data-leak, telemetry, infra. Ill also add regression abort criteria: if 5xx or auth failures >2.5x baseline or steady-state latency > 2x, pause and notify execs.
kevin: Telemetry plan: small middleware behind feature flag to record {request_id, route, latency_ms} only — no prompt or model outputs. Will be enabled for 48h and removed automatically. Patch includes tests and timed rollback job.
anita: Legal ok with limited telemetry so long as prompt text/outputs are redacted. Evidence manifest must list redaction steps and who performed them.
sana: Note on RBAC export: I'll include resource bindings, service accounts, and role templates. I'll tag files with the thread ts in the evidence path.
dry-run: devops-bot scheduled a dry-run for Fri 10:30am PT and added attendees: mike, sana, sam, kevin, ryan, anita. Reminder 15m prior.
ryan: Ops constraint: do not apply IAM changes earlier than 15m before the start to avoid stale access. Approvals enforced via ops-request. Also will set bucket-object hold after upload.
mike: Add incident crib to the runbook: contact list, rollback steps (revoke ephemeral role, remove middleware), and quick checks (auth-suc rate, 5xx rate, queue depth). If escalated, use #release-war-room and tag me.
sam: I'll add an alert that auto-triggers the rollback playbook and pings on-call + execs. Also adding a post-engagement verification checklist (hash verify, manifest signed, logs archived).
kevin: PR ready for the IAM condition + role creation; will include exact SA for assessors and a how-to for request/verify. Posting link when live.
anita: I'll upload evidence_receipt template and redaction checklist to the runbook. Legal will sign post-engagement.
mike: Please drop any pre-engagement exceptions (whitelist IPs, special endpoints, privileged service accounts) into this thread by EOD Friday so I can finalize the runbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
